name: decky-cachy-update
description: Run cachy-update from the Steam Deck quick-access menu

scripts.package: pnpm build && rm -rf out && mkdir -p out/"CachyOS Update"/dist && cp plugin.json main.py package.json out/"CachyOS Update"/ && cp dist/index.js out/"CachyOS Update"/dist/ && cd out && zip -r ../decky-cachy-update.zip "CachyOS Update" && cd .. && rm -rf out && echo 'Created decky-cachy-update.zip'
